relationships.subject: Rac1
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective inhibition of Rac1 protein has been shown to attenuate hyperalgesia and reduce the changes in dendritic spines in an animal model of neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: chronic nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic nerve injury also promotes autophagy and apoptosis in the inhibitory γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) interneurons, and reduces the activity of GABA synthase and glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), ultimately leading to neuronal disinhibition

relationships.subject: PDK
relationships.evidence_quote: Pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) is a rate-limiting enzyme in the TCA cycle, and is regulated (inhibited) via phosphorylation by pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase (PDK).

relationships.subject: spinal PDK2/PDK4
relationships.evidence_quote: double knockout of PDK2 and PDK4 could alleviate hyperalgesia via inhibiting synaptic accumulation of pro-inflammatory factors and lactate

relationships.subject: dichloroacetate
relationships.evidence_quote: The PDK inhibitor dichloroacetate and LDH inhibitor FX11 partially alleviate hyperalgesia in diabetic neuralgia model

relationships.subject: FX11
relationships.evidence_quote: The PDK inhibitor dichloroacetate and LDH inhibitor FX11 partially alleviate hyperalgesia in diabetic neuralgia model

relationships.subject: beta amyloid
relationships.evidence_quote: Short-term exposure to β amyloid shifts microglia from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis via the mammalian target of rapamycin/hypoxia inducible factor-1α (mTOR/HIF-1α) pathway

relationships.subject: lactate
relationships.evidence_quote: in endothelial cells, lactate accumulation stimulates the NF-κB/IL-8 pathway and induces the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), resulting in increased cytomembrane permeability and blood-brain barrier disruption

relationships.subject: lactate
relationships.evidence_quote: Lactate inhibits toll-like receptor induction of inflammasome and production of IL-1β via the GPR81-mediated suppression of innate immunity

key_findings: Review: glycometabolism reprogramming (shift from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis) in microglia and astrocytes promotes pro-inflammatory phenotypes, ROS and central sensitization in neuropathic pain.
Lactate from the astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle and PDK/LDH activity contribute to hyperalgesia; PDK2/PDK4 knockout, dichloroacetate and FX11 alleviate pain in diabetic neuralgia models.
